class.name: ProxyCloth
class.brief_description: Coarse XPBD cloth that refines a skinned target pose and drives a render mesh.
class.description: Particles follow a skinned target (for example a spring-bone pose) within a per-particle max distance, with stretch and bend constraints, gravity, inertia and capsule collision, stepped with substeps at the rendered frame rate. [method write_mesh] writes the target-skinned render mesh plus the particles' offsets from their targets into a mesh surface created with [constant Mesh.ARRAY_FLAG_USE_DYNAMIC_UPDATE]. With [member blend] at 0 the render mesh equals the target-skinned mesh, so switching to and from bone skinning is seamless.
